newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil ends higher on futures, firm premiums.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil ends higher on futures, firm premiums.

text.p: NWE gas oil ended higher on Tuesday after futures recovered from lower levels in afternoon trading.
Despite higher premiums, the heating oil barge market was fairly busy with trades for second half September delivery reported at Oct +$10 and +$11 fob Rotterdam and also Oct +$8 fob Antwerp.
"Most the buyers are covering shorts," one trader said. "You wouldn't come in otherwise at these levels." Many players were trying to sort out October requirements well in advance.

One barge traded at Oct +$5.50 fob ARA for first half October delivery. The cargo market, in contrast, was fairly quiet. Traders put this down more to a lack of available prompt cargoes than lack of ready buyers.

A few traders expressed concern over the amount of North American gas oil due to hit Europe in October -- shipbrokers have reported that at least six European-bound gas oil cargoes are due to leave North America before the end of September. Others dismissed these fears, saying European demand was so strong that cargoes would be easily taken into the market.
